text:
Talia: Quick follow-up from Orbitix onboarding 2nd call 1: they called out billing transparency as a blocker for procurement.
Noah: What exactly do they need?
Talia: Two items: (A) export with per-route token counts + costs for last 90 days, CSV; (B) an errors timeline (timestamps + error_code) for audit. Both must be delivered to procurement before their legal review in 10 business days.
Lee: We can generate both from events_db. Will redact emails/user ids. Suggest we return transcript_length instead of full transcripts.
Renee: I'll prepare a 1-pager and a 15m walkthrough focused on how finance can pivot the CSV into chargebacks. Also will record the session.
Noah: Product note: this is a recurring ask across customers 1 especially mid-market. Can we add "account export (per-route CSV + TTL presigned link)" to backlog? Acceptance: schema documented, RBAC enforced, export TTL + audit log.
Talia: Orbitix said they prefer presigned S3 link delivered to their procurement email.
Lee: Quick export snippet I'll run (redacts emails):
```bash
psql events -c "COPY (SELECT account_id, route, prompt_tokens AS tokens_in, completion_tokens AS tokens_out, (prompt_tokens+completion_tokens)*rate AS cost_usd, COALESCE(error_code,'') AS error_code, recorded_at FROM events_raw WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '90 days') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" | sed -E 's/[^,]+@[^,]+/REDACTED_EMAIL/g' > orbitix_route_90d.csv
```
Noah: Good. Action items: 1) Lee run redacted export and share presigned link by Thu EOD. 2) Renee prep 1-pager + record walkthrough. 3) Noah add product ticket and tag security for RBAC/audit. 4) Talia confirm with Orbitix that presigned link is acceptable.
CS-Bot: Reminder  Orbitix renewal check in 10 business days (calendar invite created).
Talia: I'll update Orbitix after the CSV is available.
Renee: Will attach the walkthrough to onboarding repo for reuse.
Noah: Thanks all, I'll scope the MVP and include sample curl for presign.
